title: Addon for Keep Some Inventory - Axolotl Buckets +
description: Add support for Axolotl Buckets + to Keep Some Inventory.
body:
Drop your modded axolotl buckets on death! 

"Keep Some Inventory" by PuckiSilver allows you to keep certain items on death. "Axolotl Buckets +" by Shadow_X_05 adds new bucket items for the unrepresented (non-pink) axolotl variants.

> [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/shadow-x-axolotl-buckets-plus](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/shadow-x-axolotl-buckets-plus)

This addon is for people who want the extra axolotl buckets to drop on death when you are using both of these mods together.

However, as of Keep Some Inventory `v2.0.1`, the vanilla axolotl bucket will not drop on death. You can modify my downloaded file to do this.

Keep Some Inventory uses an exclusion list to decide which items will be dropped on player death. This means any new items added to your game will not automatically be dropped on death. Rather, they will be kept. As such, addons can be used to extend this exclusion list without modifying the source (Keep Some Inventory). These addons are in data pack format. 

This addon is compatible with both the data pack version and the modded version of Keep Some Inventory's release.
